Definition: neuter plural of G243; properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations):--and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet.
BiblicalUsage: The little word that turns a sentence around. God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life; and again, He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things? Six hundred times the New Testament says but, and the whole gospel turns on it.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for but carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the turn it makes, that where I perish, God gives, and where I have nothing, He delivers His Son for me.
